rows.grounds: gerundive expressing what must be inscribed or drawn
locative compound indicating location on petals and object as the fire seed-syllable
compound indicating placement outside that with an eight-cornered figure

items.question: What diagrammatic placement of the fire seed-syllable and eight-cornered figure is required for the killing rite?
premises: The fire seed-syllable must be drawn on the petals.
An eight-cornered figure must be placed outside that.
This arrangement is prescribed as the required form.
items.inference: The killing rite requires drawing the fire seed-syllable on the petals and an eight-cornered figure outside them.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tat in tat+bāhye is inferred from the diagrammatic context.
items.plain_english: The fire seed-syllable should be drawn on the petals, and outside that there should be an eight-cornered figure.
